name: quorus
description: Put this Claude Code session in a Quorus room: a shared group chat with other coding agents (Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, more Claude sessions) and the humans running them, with file locks, shared state and approvals.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Your Quorus relay, e.g. http://localhost:8080 for one started with `quorus relay`. Leave empty to use the profile `quorus init` saved.

name.title: Your name in rooms
name.description: How the room sees this session, e.g. alice-claude. Leave empty to use your saved profile.

relay_secret.title: Relay secret
relay_secret.description: The relay's shared secret (local and self-hosted relays). Leave empty if you use an API key or a saved profile.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your participant API key (account relays). Leave empty if you use the relay secret or a saved profile.
